task.summary: 本文介绍 Kubernetes 中 Deployment 的概念、用途和操作方法。Deployment 通过声明期望状态，由控制器以受控速率创建和更新 ReplicaSet 及其 Pods，支持发布、状态检查、回滚、扩缩容、暂停与恢复发布以及清理旧 ReplicaSet。文档还说明了 Deployment 配置字段、选择器与标签的关系、发布状态查看方式，以及 pod-template-hash 标签的作用和使用限制。

segments.source: Deployments
segments.target: 部署

segments.source:
A _Deployment_ provides declarative updates for Pods and
ReplicaSets.
segments.target:
*部署* 为 Pod 和
副本集提供声明式更新。

segments.source: You describe a _desired state_ in a Deployment, and the Deployment controller changes the actual state to the desired state at a controlled rate. You can define Deployments to create new ReplicaSets, or to remove existing Deployments and adopt all their resources with new Deployments.
segments.target: 你可以在 Deployment 中描述期望状态，Deployment 控制器会以受控速率将实际状态更改为期望状态。你可以定义 Deployment 来创建新的副本集；也可以删除现有 Deployment，并由新的 Deployment 接管其所有资源。

segments.source: Do not manage ReplicaSets owned by a Deployment. Consider opening an issue in the main Kubernetes repository if your use case is not covered below.
segments.target: 不要管理由 Deployment 管理的 ReplicaSet。如果你的用例未涵盖在下文中，请考虑在 Kubernetes 主仓库中提交 issue。

segments.source: Use Case
segments.target: 用例

segments.source: The following are typical use cases for Deployments:
segments.target: 以下是 Deployment 的典型用例：

segments.source: [Create a Deployment to rollout a ReplicaSet](#creating-a-deployment). The ReplicaSet creates Pods in the background. Check the status of the rollout to see if it succeeds or not.
segments.target: [创建 Deployment 以发布 ReplicaSet](#creating-a-deployment)。ReplicaSet 在后台创建 Pod。检查发布状态以确定其是否成功。

segments.source: [Declare the new state of the Pods](#updating-a-deployment) by updating the PodTemplateSpec of the Deployment. A new ReplicaSet is created, and the Deployment gradually scales it up while scaling down the old ReplicaSet, ensuring Pods are replaced at a controlled rate. Each new ReplicaSet updates the revision of the Deployment.
segments.target: [通过更新 Deployment 的 PodTemplateSpec 来声明 Pod 的新状态](#updating-a-deployment)。系统会创建一个新的 ReplicaSet，并在缩减旧 ReplicaSet 的同时逐步扩展新 ReplicaSet，从而确保以受控速率替换 Pod。每个新的 ReplicaSet 都会更新 Deployment 的修订版本。

segments.source: [Rollback to an earlier Deployment revision](#rolling-back-a-deployment) if the current state of the Deployment is not stable. Each rollback updates the revision of the Deployment.
segments.target: [如果 Deployment 的当前状态不稳定，则回滚到较早的 Deployment 修订版本](#rolling-back-a-deployment)。每次回滚都会更新 Deployment 的修订版本。

segments.source: [Scale up the Deployment to facilitate more load](#scaling-a-deployment).
segments.target: [扩展 Deployment 以承载更多负载](#scaling-a-deployment)。

segments.source: [Pause the rollout of a Deployment](#pausing-and-resuming-a-deployment) to apply multiple fixes to its PodTemplateSpec and then resume it to start a new rollout.
segments.target: [暂停 Deployment 的发布](#pausing-and-resuming-a-deployment)，以便对其 PodTemplateSpec 应用多个修复，然后恢复发布以启动新的发布。

segments.source: [Use the status of the Deployment](#deployment-status) as an indicator that a rollout has stuck.
segments.target: [将 Deployment 的状态](#deployment-status)用作发布卡住的指示。

segments.source: [Clean up older ReplicaSets](#clean-up-policy) that you don't need anymore.
segments.target: [清理不再需要的旧副本集](#clean-up-policy)。

segments.source: Creating a Deployment
segments.target: 创建 Deployment

segments.source: The following is an example of a Deployment. It creates a ReplicaSet to bring up three `nginx` Pods:
segments.target: 以下是一个 Deployment 示例。它会创建一个 ReplicaSet，以启动三个 `nginx` Pod：

segments.source: In this example:
segments.target: 在此示例中：

segments.source:
A Deployment named `nginx-deployment` is created, indicated by the
  `.metadata.name` field. This name will become the basis for the ReplicaSets
  and Pods which are created later. See [Writing a Deployment Spec](#writing-a-deployment-spec)
  for more details.
segments.target: 创建了一个名为 `nginx-deployment` 的 Deployment，这由 `.metadata.name` 字段指示。此名称将成为之后创建的 ReplicaSet 和 Pod 的基础。有关详细信息，请参阅[编写 Deployment 规范](#writing-a-deployment-spec)。

segments.source: The Deployment creates a ReplicaSet that creates three replicated Pods, indicated by the `.spec.replicas` field.
segments.target: Deployment 会创建一个 ReplicaSet，而该 ReplicaSet 会创建三个副本 Pod，这由 `.spec.replicas` 字段指示。

segments.source:
The `.spec.selector` field defines how the created ReplicaSet finds which Pods to manage.
  In this case, you select a label that is defined in the Pod template (`app: nginx`).
  However, more sophisticated selection rules are possible,
  as long as the Pod template itself satisfies the rule.
segments.target: `.spec.selector` 字段定义了所创建的 ReplicaSet 如何查找要管理的 Pod。在此例中，你选择了 Pod 模板中定义的标签（`app: nginx`）。不过，只要 Pod 模板本身满足规则，也可以使用更复杂的选择规则。

segments.source:
The `.spec.selector.matchLabels` field is a map of {key,value} pairs.
  A single {key,value} in the `matchLabels` map is equivalent to an element of `matchExpressions`,
  whose `key` field is "key", the `operator` is "In", and the `values` array contains only "value".
  All of the requirements, from both `matchLabels` and `matchExpressions`, must be satisfied in order to match.
segments.target: `.spec.selector.matchLabels` 字段是 {key,value} 对的映射。`matchLabels` 映射中的单个 {key,value} 等价于 `matchExpressions` 的一个元素，其中 `key` 字段为 "key"，`operator` 为 "In"，而 `values` 数组仅包含 "value"。要匹配，必须满足来自 `matchLabels` 和 `matchExpressions` 的所有要求。

segments.source: The `.spec.template` field contains the following sub-fields:
segments.target: `.spec.template` 字段包含以下子字段：

segments.source: The Pods are labeled `app: nginx`using the `.metadata.labels` field.
segments.target: Pod 使用 `.metadata.labels` 字段标记为 `app: nginx`。

segments.source:
The Pod template's specification, or `.spec` field, indicates that
    the Pods run one container, `nginx`, which runs the `nginx`
    [Docker Hub](https://hub.docker.com/) image at version 1.14.2.
segments.target: Pod 模板的规范，即 `.spec` 字段，表示 Pod 运行一个容器 `nginx`，该容器运行 `nginx` [Docker Hub](https://hub.docker.com/)] 镜像的 1.14.2 版本。

segments.source: Create one container and name it `nginx` using the `.spec.containers[0].name` field.
segments.target: 使用 `.spec.containers[0].name` 字段创建一个容器，并将其命名为 `nginx`。

segments.source:
Before you begin, make sure your Kubernetes cluster is up and running.
Follow the steps given below to create the above Deployment:
segments.target:
开始之前，请确保你的 Kubernetes 集群已启动并正在运行。
按照以下步骤创建上述 Deployment：

segments.source: Create the Deployment by running the following command:
segments.target: 运行以下命令创建 Deployment：

segments.source:
```shell
   kubectl apply -f https://k8s.io/examples/controllers/nginx-deployment.yaml
   ```
Run `kubectl get deployments` to check if the Deployment was created.
segments.target: 运行 `kubectl get deployments`，检查 Deployment 是否已创建。

segments.source: If the Deployment is still being created, the output is similar to the following:
segments.target: 如果 Deployment 仍在创建中，输出类似如下内容：

segments.source:
```
   NAME               READY   UP-TO-DATE   AVAILABLE   AGE
   nginx-deployment   0/3     0            0           1s
   ```
When you inspect the Deployments in your cluster, the following fields are displayed:
segments.target: 检查集群中的 Deployment 时，会显示以下字段：

segments.source: `NAME` lists the names of the Deployments in the namespace.
segments.target: `NAME` 列出命名空间中的 Deployment 名称。

segments.source: `READY` displays how many replicas of the application are available to your users. It follows the pattern ready/desired.
segments.target: `READY` 显示应用程序有多少个副本可供用户使用。其格式为 ready/desired。

segments.source: `UP-TO-DATE` displays the number of replicas that have been updated to achieve the desired state.
segments.target: `UP-TO-DATE` 显示为达到期望状态而已更新的副本数。

segments.source: `AVAILABLE` displays how many replicas of the application are available to your users.
segments.target: `AVAILABLE` 显示应用程序有多少个副本可供用户使用。

segments.source: `AGE` displays the amount of time that the application has been running.
segments.target: `AGE` 显示应用程序已运行的时间。

segments.source: Notice how the number of desired replicas is 3 according to `.spec.replicas` field.
segments.target: 注意，根据 `.spec.replicas` 字段，期望副本数为 3。

segments.source: To see the Deployment rollout status, run `kubectl rollout status deployment/nginx-deployment`.
segments.target: 要查看 Deployment 发布状态，请运行 `kubectl rollout status deployment/nginx-deployment`。

segments.source: The output is similar to:
segments.target: 输出类似如下内容：

segments.source:
```
   Waiting for rollout to finish: 2 out of 3 new replicas have been updated...
   deployment "nginx-deployment" successfully rolled out
   ```

Run the `kubectl get deployments` again a few seconds later.
   The output is similar to this:
segments.target:
几秒钟后再次运行 `kubectl get deployments`。
   输出类似如下内容：

segments.source:
```
   NAME               READY   UP-TO-DATE   AVAILABLE   AGE
   nginx-deployment   3/3     3            3           18s
   ```
Notice that the Deployment has created all three replicas, and all replicas are up-to-date (they contain the latest Pod template) and available.
segments.target: 注意，Deployment 已创建全部三个副本，并且所有副本都是最新的（包含最新的 Pod 模板）且可用。

segments.source: To see the ReplicaSet (`rs`) created by the Deployment, run `kubectl get rs`. The output is similar to this:
segments.target: 要查看 Deployment 创建的 ReplicaSet（`rs`），请运行 `kubectl get rs`。输出类似如下内容：

segments.source:
```
   NAME                          DESIRED   CURRENT   READY   AGE
   nginx-deployment-75675f5897   3         3         3       18s
   ```
ReplicaSet output shows the following fields:
segments.target: ReplicaSet 输出显示以下字段：

segments.source: `NAME` lists the names of the ReplicaSets in the namespace.
segments.target: `NAME` 列出命名空间中的 ReplicaSet 名称。

segments.source: `DESIRED` displays the desired number of _replicas_ of the application, which you define when you create the Deployment. This is the _desired state_.
segments.target: `DESIRED` 显示应用程序的期望副本数，你在创建 Deployment 时定义该副本数。这就是期望状态。

segments.source: `CURRENT` displays how many replicas are currently running.
segments.target: `CURRENT` 显示当前正在运行的副本数。

segments.source: `READY` displays how many replicas of the application are available to your users.
segments.target: `READY` 显示应用程序有多少个副本可供用户使用。

segments.source: `AGE` displays the amount of time that the application has been running.
segments.target: `AGE` 显示应用程序已运行的时间。

segments.source:
Notice that the name of the ReplicaSet is always formatted as
   `[DEPLOYMENT-NAME]-[HASH]`. This name will become the basis for the Pods
   which are created.
segments.target: 注意，ReplicaSet 的名称始终采用 `[DEPLOYMENT-NAME]-[HASH]` 的格式。此名称将成为所创建 Pod 的基础。

segments.source: The `HASH` string is the same as the `pod-template-hash` label on the ReplicaSet.
segments.target: `HASH` 字符串与 ReplicaSet 上的 `pod-template-hash` 标签相同。

segments.source:
To see the labels automatically generated for each Pod, run `kubectl get pods --show-labels`.
   The output is similar to:
segments.target:
要查看为每个 Pod 自动生成的标签，请运行 `kubectl get pods --show-labels`。
   输出类似如下内容：

segments.source:
```
   NAME                                READY     STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE       LABELS
   nginx-deployment-75675f5897-7ci7o   1/1       Running   0          18s       app=nginx,pod-template-hash=75675f5897
   nginx-deployment-75675f5897-kzszj   1/1       Running   0          18s       app=nginx,pod-template-hash=75675f5897
   nginx-deployment-75675f5897-qqcnn   1/1       Running   0          18s       app=nginx,pod-template-hash=75675f5897
   ```
The created ReplicaSet ensures that there are three `nginx` Pods.
segments.target: 所创建的 ReplicaSet 确保存在三个 `nginx` Pod。

segments.source:
You must specify an appropriate selector and Pod template labels in a Deployment
(in this case, `app: nginx`).
segments.target: 你必须在 Deployment 中指定适当的选择器和 Pod 模板标签（此例中为 `app: nginx`）。

segments.source: Do not overlap labels or selectors with other controllers (including other Deployments and StatefulSets). Kubernetes doesn't stop you from overlapping, and if multiple controllers have overlapping selectors those controllers might conflict and behave unexpectedly.
segments.target: 不要让标签或选择器与其他控制器（包括其他 Deployment 和 StatefulSets）重叠。Kubernetes 不会阻止你进行重叠；如果多个控制器的选择器重叠，这些控制器可能会发生冲突并出现意外行为。

segments.source: Pod-template-hash label
segments.target: Pod-template-hash 标签

segments.source: Do not change this label.
segments.target: 不要更改此标签。

segments.source: The `pod-template-hash` label is added by the Deployment controller to every ReplicaSet that a Deployment creates or adopts.
segments.target: Deployment 控制器会将 `pod-template-hash` 标签添加到 Deployment 创建或接管的每个 ReplicaSet。

segments.source:
This label ensures that child ReplicaSets of a Deployment do not overlap. It is generated by hashing the `PodTemplate` of the ReplicaSet and using the resulting hash as the label value that is added to the ReplicaSet selector, Pod template labels,
and in any existing Pods that the ReplicaSet might have.
segments.target: 此标签确保 Deployment 的子 ReplicaSet 不会发生重叠。该标签通过对 ReplicaSet 的 `PodTemplate` 进行哈希处理生成，并将生成的哈希值作为标签值添加到 ReplicaSet 选择器、Pod 模板标签，以及 ReplicaSet 可能已有的任何 Pod 中。
